subject: computer-science
title: Virtual Memory and Paging
welcome_lead: Use disk as extra RAM and trade pages in and out with virtual memory.
meta_desc: CS adventure on virtual memory, paging and page replacement strategies.
final_note: Virtual memory creates the illusion of vast RAM!

concepts.def: Physical RAM slot holding a page.
Access to a page not in RAM.
Maps virtual pages to physical frames.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Virtual address splits into page number and offset.

Page table gives frame; combine with offset for physical address.

Process accesses page not in RAM; OS fetches from disk.

If RAM full, choose victim page via replacement policy.

Least Recently Used evicts page unused for longest.

Approximated by reference bits to save bookkeeping.
